sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the explanation of the maamar's interpretation of "Gal Einai" is that seeing the wonders of Torah must come through the revealed Torah, so that the body of Torah reveals its soul, affecting the person similarly.

translations.translation: And based on this, we may explain what is said in the maamar28
that the interpretation of "Uncover my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah" is that the seeing of the wonders of Torah
(the soul of the Torah and the soul of the soul)
will be from Your Torah,
from the revealed Torah,
for at first glance,
the main thing is that he should see the wonders of Torah,
and what is the advantage in that he should see them through the matters that are in the revealed aspect of Torah.
And we may say the explanation of this,
that all the matters in the world and in man,
their beginning is in Torah29.
Therefore,
by means of the seeing of the wonders of Torah
(of the person)
being through these matters that are in the revealed aspect of Torah,
that is, the body and the garment of Torah itself reveal the soul and the soul of the soul of Torah,
through this it is likewise effected also in the person who engages in Torah,
that this seeing of the wonders of Torah is
(also)
from the aspect of the person's own being.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The two aspects of nullifying the barrier between upper and lower that were renewed at Matan Torah correspond generally to Torah and mitzvos, with Torah primarily involving the descent of the upper to the lower and mitzvos primarily involving the ascent of the lower to the upper.

translations.translation: e)

Now, the two aforementioned matters in the nullification of the decree and the partition between the upper ones and the lower ones that were renewed at the Giving of the Torah are, in a more general sense, Torah and mitzvos.
For the matter of the descent of the upper ones below that was renewed at the Giving of the Torah is primarily in Torah,
and the matter of the ascent of the lower ones above that was renewed at the Giving of the Torah is primarily in mitzvos30.
And the concept is,
that from the distinctions between Torah and mitzvos is31,
that Torah is the word of G-d,
the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He,
except that it descended below and became clothed in human intellect in order that man could understand and comprehend it,
and the mitzvos, which are commandments to man,
the intention and purpose in them is
(not the commandment itself,
but rather)
the fulfillment of the commandment that man performs.
And this is that the matter of the descent of the upper ones below is primarily in Torah,
for Torah,
which is the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He,
its place is above32,
and that the Torah was given below and became clothed in human intellect and in physical matters is the matter of the descent of the upper ones to the lower ones
(not so regarding the giving of the mitzvos below is the matter of the descent of the upper ones below not so emphasized,
for on the contrary,
the matter of the mitzvos
(commandments)
is that man should fulfill them).
And the matter of the lower ones ascending to the upper ones is primarily in mitzvos.
For in Torah,
since even after it descended below it is the word of G-d,
therefore,
even in the study and engagement of Torah by man, what is primarily felt is the drawing down from above,
that the Torah, which is the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He, is drawn down and becomes clothed in the intellect of man,
and not the refinement and purification of man's intellect.
And the matter that the lower ones ascend to the upper ones is emphasized primarily in mitzvos,
for since the matter of the mitzvos
(commandments)
is that man should fulfill the mitzvos
(as above),
and the intention in this is in order to refine the creations33,

in order to clarify, refine, and elevate the powers and limbs of the person who performs the mitzvah, and also the things in the world with which the mitzvah is performed, and to make them into vessels for G-dliness,
the matter of mitzvos is the ascent of the lower ones above.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Since the main purpose of nullifying the barrier at Matan Torah is the ascent of the lower, the phrase "I will behold wonders from Your Torah" includes mitzvos as they are from the soul of Torah, requiring study of the Torah's body for the mitzvah's body and study of the Torah's soul for the mitzvah's soul.

translations.translation: And according to what was explained above
(section d)
that the main intention in the nullification of the decree at the Giving of the Torah is that the lower ones ascend above,
and likewise regarding the nullification of the decree and the partition concerning the innerness of Torah
("Uncover my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah")
that the main thing is the ascent from below to above,
it must be said,
that in "I will behold wonders from Your Torah" is also included the matter of mitzvos as they are from the aspect of the soul of the Torah.
And therefore the Tzemach Tzedek brings the interpretation of the Shelah that "wonders from Your Torah" are the intentions of the mitzvos.
And the concept is,
that in order for the fulfillment of mitzvos to be proper, it is through the study of Torah,
for study leads to action34.
And it may be said,
that in order for the action of the mitzvah
(the body of the mitzvah35)
to be proper, it is through the study of the revealed aspect of Torah
(the body of Torah),
and in order for the intention of the mitzvos
(the soul of the mitzvos35)
to be proper, it is through the study of the innerness of Torah
(the soul of the Torah).
